朱延龄（1937— ） 中国美术家协会会员，
第一届儿童美术艺术委员会副主任。
1956年7月毕业于上海艺术师范。历任少年儿童出版社美术编辑、美术室主任、总编辑助理、
上海画报出版社总编辑、社长。出版有《百花仙子》、《芭蕉扇》等儿童读物绘本二十余册、长篇
连续漫画《小豆子》等。
page_text_en:
Zhu Yanling (1937— ) is a member of the China Artists Association and vice chairman of the First Children's Art Committee.
Graduated from Shanghai Art Teachers' College in July 1956. He has served as art editor, head of the art department, assistant chief editor, chief editor, and president of the Shanghai Pictorial Publishing House. He has published over twenty children's picture books, including "Hundred Flowers Fairy" and "Banana Fan," as well as the long-running comic series "Little Bean."
summary_zh: 本页展示了作者朱延龄的肖像及其生平简介，包括其艺术背景、职业经历和主要作品。
